findings.text: follow-on: the fragment's "11 tests each" reads the census pass count, while the same logs report "11 passed, 2 skipped"; the two skipped tests are pytest.mark.slow cases and the fragment does not say so, so a reader cannot tell the skipped set from the passed set.

follow-on: the census block stores "tests": 11 as the count of parsed slowest-duration lines (len(durations)), not the passed-test count; the two agree here but the field name is not the quantity it holds.

item_verdicts.diff: The run's own diff c090222b..ef9174d1e is the single evidence fragment; the code change the gate certifies is the merged branch a28856c8..c090222b (benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py, scripts/analytic_oracle_fixtures/measure.py), which is what comparison.json's base_sha/head_sha name.
item_verdicts.done_when: I confirmed from comparison.json and the six per-arm receipts that base-default and head-chord are bit-identical in all 9 hashed arrays for both cases, that each head-exact arm's solving operator reported exact and its arrays differ from head-chord in 4 of 9, and that tests/test_forward_census.py ran to completion in both extracted trees with the reported durations.
item_verdicts.goal: The node's goal - show the certificate hub keeps a chord row bit-identical and carries an explicit exact mode to the solving operator - is delivered by two cases at the smallest rung in three arms each, and I re-derived every claim from the run's own receipts.
item_verdicts.manifest: The manifest reads complete with matching artifacts, changed_paths, commits and test_logs; the H200 lane log lane-hub-gate6.log carries EXIT_STATUS=0 and SCRATCH_REMOVED=True, reconciled with comparison.json.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The run wrote only docs/evidence/fragments/forward-solve-api/fsapi-clip-mode-certificate-hub-gate.html; commits 0a2106004 and ef9174d1e each touch that one file, and the gate driver, per-arm helper and fragment builder live in the run directory, not the tracked tree.

justifications.durability: The fragment is committed and the per-arm receipts and comparison.json persist under the run directory, but the gate driver certificate_hub_gate.py and helper certificate_row_arm.py are not in the tracked tree, so re-running the gate needs the run directory.
justifications.evidence: The SHA-256 bit-identity is over each row's float64 bytes computed by certificate_row_arm.py's _hash_arrays, the operator mode is captured by wrapping the real _certificate_solve_request rather than echoed from a receipt, and the exact-vs-chord 4-of-9 difference is a positive control that the instrument is sensitive to a real change; the gate driver nonetheless exits 0 unconditionally, so the identity verdict lives in comparison.json a reader must interpret.
justifications.fit: The fragment follows the forward-solve-api evidence idiom - section id, h2 headings, tables of arm/requested clip/receipt clip/solving operator/residual/converged - and cites project-relative paths.
justifications.goal_fidelity: Both questions the fragment poses are answered by artefacts the reviewer re-derived - 9/9 array hashes identical between base a28856c81 and head c090222b2 chord arms in both cases, and OPERATOR_ACTIVE=exact with DEFAULTS_CLIP=exact printed by each head-exact arm log.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat on 0a2106004 and ef9174d1e returns exactly one path each, the fragment, and the worktree carried no other tracked change.
